en.name: Private Moments
en.subtitle: A quiet, private journal
en.promotionalText: Record a moment, reflect on your mood, and keep a private note. Your journal stays on this device unless you choose to export a backup.
en.description:
Private Moments is a personal journal for recording moments at your own pace.

• Start a timer, then save a recap with a mood, rating, tags, and an optional private note.
• Browse, search, filter, edit, and delete saved entries.
• Keep entries on this device. This release has no account or app-run cloud sync, ads, analytics, health service, or partner sharing.
• Optionally lock the journal using the authentication method configured on your device.
• Export an unencrypted JSON backup or restore one. Backups include private notes; choose a destination you trust.
• English and Simplified Chinese follow your iOS language setting.

The app requests local file protection and backup exclusion; exclusion cannot be guaranteed. Deleting an entry in the app does not delete any backup copy that you exported. The app does not request location permission; an imported backup may contain an optional place label. Private Moments is not a medical or health advice service.

zh-Hans.name: 私密时刻
zh-Hans.subtitle: 安静记录，只留给自己
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 记录心情、评分与私密笔记。内容保存在本机；只有你主动导出时，才会生成可能包含私密笔记的备份文件。
zh-Hans.description:
「私密时刻」是一款个人日记，让你按照自己的节奏记录生活中的时刻。

• 开始计时，并在结束后记录心情、评分、标签和可选的私密笔记。
• 浏览、搜索、筛选、编辑或删除已保存的记录。
• 记录保存在本机。本版本没有账户、应用自建云同步、广告、分析统计、健康服务或伴侣共享。
• 可选使用此设备已设置的验证方式锁定日记。
• 导出未加密的 JSON 备份，或从备份恢复。备份包含私密笔记，请谨慎选择保存位置。
• 支持简体中文和英文，并跟随 iOS 语言设置。

应用会请求本地文件保护和排除设备备份，但该排除设置无法保证。删除应用内记录不会删除已导出的备份副本。应用不请求位置权限；导入的备份可能包含可选地点标签。本应用不提供医疗建议。
zh-Hans.keywords: 日记,心情,个人记录,自我关怀,情感,感受,回顾
